title: Login MFA 403 Response
description: HTTP 403 bodies for POST /api/v1/auth/login when multi-factor authentication applies. `mfa_setup_required`: an enforced platform admin has not enrolled; `access_token` is an ENROLLMENT-ONLY credential (scope `mfa_enroll`, 1 hour, no refresh token) accepted only by /mfa/setup, /mfa/setup/qr, /mfa/setup/verify, /auth/me and logout; it is not a session, so after enrolling the user must log in again with a code. Hold it in memory only. `mfa_required`: the user is enrolled; re-POST the same email and password with `mfa_token` (6-digit TOTP or recovery code). A wrong `mfa_token` yields HTTP 401 (see the 401 response) and an exhausted attempt budget yields HTTP 429 MFA_RATE_LIMITED.
